metadata.desc: Z-Library book search and download for AstrBot: automatic mirror failover, /zlib commands, card-image results, and an account pool that picks the freest account

account.name: Account

label.hint: Shown in logs and status only, e.g. account1

account.hint: Each account has its own daily download quota; more accounts raise the daily total

remix_userid.hint: Log in to Z-Library in a browser, press F12, open Application → Cookies and copy the value of remix_userid. Fill it together with remix_userkey

remix_userkey.hint: Same place as above; copy the value of remix_userkey. It stays valid for a long time. If both remix and email/password are set, remix wins

email.hint: Fill together with the password. The login endpoint is often rejected by risk control; use remix credentials if it fails

accounts.hint: Searching needs no account; downloading needs at least one. Add several accounts and the one with the most remaining quota is used. Remix credentials are recommended; email/password login is often blocked.

domains.hint: The plugin ships a set of directly reachable mirrors with automatic failover; domains listed here take priority. Enter host names only, e.g. z-lib.sk. Onion addresses need a Tor SOCKS proxy. The official main domains require browser verification and cannot be reached directly

proxy.hint: e.g. http://127.0.0.1:7890. Onion domains require a Tor SOCKS proxy; with Docker Compose this is usually socks5://tor:9050

max_download_mb.hint: Prevents abnormal responses from exhausting memory; valid range 1-512

search_limit.hint: Range 1-10; larger values are capped to keep the card image short

search_timeout.hint: Switching mirrors one by one is slow when they are flaky; a hint is sent on timeout. Range 5-300; raise it on poor networks or behind a proxy

card_enabled.description: Show search results as a card image
card_enabled.hint: When off, replies are plain-text lists; plain text is also used automatically if the renderer is unavailable

download_admin_only.hint: Downloads spend the accounts' daily quota; when on, /zlib download and the LLM download tool are admin-only
